evidence.event: Garmin Marathon in the Land of Oz
evidence.note: The 2017 event offered marathon, half marathon, and 10K distances. The medal photo confirms participation but does not clearly identify the distance, and the Strava export has no matching activity on race weekend.
Likely associated with the 2022 Stampede/Ranch Hand weekend, but the photo alone does not identify which race leg or category produced the award.
